issues: Data correct. I re-fetched the PL&B abstract page (International Report February 2020) on 2026-09-23. The quote 'The numbers of new countries with laws per decade are: 1970s – 10; 1980s – 10; 1990s – 20; 2000s – 40; 2010s – 62. This gives a total of 142 countries.' is verbatim (--check FOUND). All five points (10, 10, 20, 40, 62) match. They sum to 142, which matches the notes' 'cumulative total 142 by end-2019'. The page puts the 62 in 'The decade 2010-2019', so plotting it at 2019 is consistent.

Source metadata is not verbatim. The page title is '2020 ends a decade of 62 new data privacy laws'. The '(with Bertil Cottier)' in the record's title field is not part of the title. The page names both authors, 'Graham Greenleaf, PL&B Asia Pacific Editor and Bertil Cottier, Professor of Law, University of Lugano, Switzerland'. The institution field names only Greenleaf. The issue number (163) is missing. Greenleaf's own bibliography (www2.austlii.edu.au/~graham/) cites it as '(2020)163 Privacy Laws & Business International Report 24-26'.

Caveat missing from the notes. Greenleaf's 'countries' are not only sovereign states. The same page projects 'over 200 countries (including self-governing territories)', and his tables count places such as Hong Kong SAR and Jersey. Readers should also know this is a February 2020 snapshot that Greenleaf revises as laws are 'enacted or located'. The same page says ten laws were 'enacted or located' since the January 2019 tables. His June 2025 update (PL&B Int. Rep. 195) reaches 172 laws by March 2025.

No independent full-text copy could be fetched: SSRN 3572611, AustLII and ResearchGate all returned HTTP 403. The decade figures therefore rest on the PL&B abstract page alone. It is the authors' own publication, so that is adequate.

fieldFixes.notes: Greenleaf and Cottier's decade counts, from PL&B International Report 163 (February 2020). Points are plotted at each decade's final year. The cumulative total is 142 by end-2019. 'Countries' is Greenleaf's usage and includes self-governing territories. The counts are a snapshot that his later tables revise as laws are enacted or located; his June 2025 update reports 172 laws by March 2025.

addSources.title: 172 Countries with Data Privacy Laws – Year by Year 1973-2025
addSources.quote: For the past 52 years since 1973 when Sweden enacted the first national data privacy law, countries around the world have enacted new data privacy laws at an average rate of 3.3 new countries per year, giving a total of 172 laws by March 2025.
addSources.note: --check FOUND on 2026-09-23 on the free abstract page; the full table is for subscribers only. It is the author's later update of the same series. It confirms the count starts from Sweden's 1973 national law, not Hesse's 1970 state law. It also shows the 2020 decade counts are a snapshot that later tables extend and revise.
